πέμπω.long: I send, transmit, permit to go, put forth.
πέμπω.sd: to dispatch (from the subjective view or point of departure, whereas (as a stronger form of ) refers rather to the objective point or terminus ad quem, and G4724 (στέλλω) denotes properly, the orderly motion involved), especially on a temporary errand; also to transmit, bestow, or wield
πέμπω.as:
πέμπω,
[in LXX chiefly for שׁלח;]
to send;
(a) of persons: c. acc., absol., Mt 22:7, Lk 7:19, Jo 1:22, II Co 9:3, al.; ptcp. seq. verb., Mt 14:10, Ac 19:31, al.; ptcp. seq. διά (= Heb. בְּיוֹדprobably misspelled בְּיַד, I Ki 16:20, al.), Mt 11:2 (cf. Re 1:1); of teachers sent by God, Jo 1:334:34, Ro 8:3, al.; c. acc. et dat., I Co 4:17, Phl 2:19; seq. πρός, c. acc., Lk 4:26, Jo 16:7, al.; seq. λέγων (cf. Heb. שָׁלַחלֵאמֹרGe 38:25, al.), Lk 7:6, 19; seq. εἰς, c. acc. loc., Mt 2:8, Lk 15:15, al.; seq. εἰς (of purpose), Eph 6:22, Col 4:8, I Pe 2:14; c. inf., Jo 1:33, I Co 16:3, Re 22:16;
(b) of things: Re 11:10; seq. εἰς, Re 1:11; id., of purpose, Ac 11:29, Phl 4:16; c. dat. pers., II Th 2:11; π. τ. δρέπανον σου (cf. εξαποστείλατε δρέπανα = שָׁלַחמַגָּל, Jl 3 (4):13), Re 14:15, 18 (cf. ἀνα-, ἐκ-, μετα-, προ-, συν-πέμπω).
SYN.: ἀποστέλλω, q.v.

περί.sd: properly, through (all over), i.e. around; figuratively with respect to; used in various applications, of place, cause or time (with the genitive case denoting the subject or occasion or superlative point; with the accusative case the locality, circuit, matter, circumstance or general period)
περί.kj: (there-)about, above, against, at, on behalf of, X and his company, which concern, (as) concerning, for, X how it will go with, ((there-, where-)) of, on, over, pertaining (to), for sake, X (e-)state, (as) touching, (where-)by (in), with
περί.as:
περί,
prep. c. gen., acc. (in cl. also c. dat.; cf. M, Pr., 105f.),
with radical sense round about (as distinct from ἀμφί, on both sides).
I. C. gen.,
1. of place, about (poët.).
2. Causal, about, on account of, concerning, in reference to: Mt 2:8, Mk 1:44, Lk 4:38, Jo 16:26, Ac 28:21, al. mult.; τὰ περί, c. gen., the things concerning one, one's state or case: Mk 5:27, Ac 1:328:15, Eph 6:22, al.; at the beginning of a sentence, περί, regarding, as to, I Co 7:1, al.; in the sense on account of (Mt 26:28, I Co 1:13, al.), often with ὑπέρ as variant (cf. M, Pr., 105).
II. C. acc.,
1. of place, about, around: Mt 3:4, Mk 1:6, Lk 13:8, Ac 22:6, al.; οἱ περί, c. acc. pers., of one's associates, friends, etc., Mk 4:10, Lk 22:49, Jo 11:19, Ac 13:13; οἱ περὶ τ. τοιαῦτα ἐργάται, Ac 19:25; metaph., about, as to, concerning: I Ti 1:196:4, II Ti 2:183:8, Tit 2:7; τὰ περὶ ἐμέ, Phl 2:23; αἱ περὶ τ. λοιπὰ ἐπιθυμίαι, Mk 4:19.
2. Of time, in a loose reckoning, about, near: Mt 20:3, 5, 6, 927:46, Mk 6:48, Ac 10:3, 922:6.
III. In composition: round about (περιβάλλω, περίκειμαι), beyond, over and above (περιποιέω, περιλείπω), to excess (περιεργάζομαι, περισσεύω).

περίχωρος.long: neighboring; subst: the neighboring country, neighboring inhabitants.
περίχωρος.sd: around the region, i.e. circumjacent (as noun, with G1093 (γῆ) implied vicinity)
περίχωρος.kj: country (round) about, region (that lieth) round about
περίχωρος.as:
περί-χωρος, -ον,
[in LXX: chiefly (ἡ π.) for כִּכָּר;]
round about, neighbouring (Dem., Plut., al.). In LXX and NT, as subst., ἡ π. (sc. γῆ), the region round about: Mt 14:35, Mk 1:28, Lk 4:14, 377:178:37, Ac 14:6; ἡ π. τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, Lk 3:3; by meton. for the people of the same region, Mt 3:5.†

περιστερά.as:
περιστερά, -ᾶς, ἡ,
[in LXX chiefly for יוֹנָה;]
a dove: Mt 3:1610:1621:12, Mk 1:1011:15, Lk 2:243:22, Jo 1:322:14, 16.†

πειράζω.sd: to test (objectively), i.e. endeavor, scrutinize, entice, discipline
πειράζω.kj: assay, examine, go about, prove, tempt(-er), try
πειράζω.as:
πειράζω, poët. and late prose form of πειράω, q.v.,
[in LXX for נסה pi.;]
1.to make proof of (Hom.).
2.to try, attempt (Luc., Polyb., al.): c. inf. (v. M, Pr., 205; Bl., § 69, 4), Ac 9:2616:724:6.
3. In LXX and NT, like Heb. נסה, c. acc. pers., to test, try, prove;
(a) in a good sense: Jo 6:6, II Co 13:5, He 11:17, Re 2:2; esp. of trials and afflictions sent or permitted by God (Ge 22:1, Ex 20:20, Wi 3:5, al.), I Co 10:13, He 2:184:1511:17, 37, Re 3:10;
(b) in a bad sense (Apoll. Rhod., 3, 10): of the attempts made to ensnare Jesus in his speech, Mt 16:119:322:18, 35, Mk 8:1110:212:15, Lk 11:16, Jo 8:[6]; of temptation to sin, to tempt, Ja 1:13, 14 (v. Hort, in l.), Ga 6:1, Re 2:10; esp. of temptations of the devil, Mt 4:1, 3, Mk 1:13, Lk 4:2, I Co 7:5, I Th 3:5; ὁ πειράζων, the tempter, Mt 4:3, I Th 3:5;
(c) in bad sense also (Ex 17:2, 7, Nu 14:22, al.), of distrustful testing, trying or challenging of God: Ac 15:10, I Co 10:9 (WH, mg., ἐξεπείρασαν), He 3:9; τ. πνεῦμα Κυρίου, Ac 5:9 (cf. ἐκ-πειράζω).†
SYN.: δοκιμάζω, q.v.

πεινάω.long: I am hungry, needy, desire earnestly.
πεινάω.sd: "pine"); to famish (absolutely or comparatively); figuratively, to crave
πεινάω.der: from the same as G3993 (πένης) (through the idea of pinching toil;
πεινάω.as:
πεινάω, -ῶ,
[in LXX chiefly for = רָעֵב;]
to hunger, be hungry: Mt 4:212:1, 321:1825:35, 37, 42, 44, Mk 2:2511:12, Lk 1:534:26:3, Ro 12:20(LXX), I Co 4:1111:21, 34, Phl 4:12, Re 7:16; metaph., Mt 5:6, Lk 6:21, 25, Jo 6:35.†

πέραν.long: over, on the other side, beyond.
πέραν.sd: through (as adverb or preposition), i.e. across
πέραν.der: apparently accusative case of an obsolete derivative of (to "pierce");
πέραν.as:
πέραν,
adv.,
[in LXX for עֵבֶר and cognate forms;]
on the other side, across (usually with the idea of water lying between);
(a) as in the older poets, as prep. c. gen.: τ. θαλάσσης, Jo 6:1, 17, 22, 25; τ. Ἰορδάνου, Mt 4:15(LXX), 2519:1, Mk 3:810:1, Jo 1:283:2610:40; τ. χειμάρρου τ. Κέδρων, Jo 18:1;
(b)τὸ π., the region beyond, the other side: Mt 8:18, 2814:2216:5, Mk 4:355:216:458:13; τ. θαλάσσης, Mk 5:1; τ. λίμνης, Lk 8:22.†

περιπατέω.long: I walk, hence Hebraistically (in an ethical sense): I conduct my life, live.
περιπατέω.sd: to tread all around, i.e. walk at large (especially as proof of ability); figuratively, to live, deport oneself, follow (as a companion or votary)
περιπατέω.as:
περι-πατέω, -ῶ,
[in LXX chiefly for הלךְ pi., hith.;]
to walk: absol., Mt 9:5, Mk 5:42, Lk 5:23, Jo 1:36; c. pred., γυμνός, Re 16:15; ἐπάνωLk 11:44; διά, c. gen., Re 21:24; ἐν, Mk 11:2712:38, Jo 7:111:54, Re 2:1, al.; ἐν τ. σκοτίᾳ, fig., Jo 8:1212:35, I Jo 1:6, 72:11; ἐπί, c. gen., Mt 14:26; id. c. dat., Mt 14:25, 29; μετά, Jo 6:66, Re 3:4; παρά, c. acc., Mt 4:18. Metaph., of living, passing one's life, conducting oneself (like ἀναστρέφομαι in Xen., Plut., LXX, π.; M, Pr., 11; Deiss., BS, 194): ἀκριβῶς, Eph 5:15; ἀτάκτως, II Th 3:6, 11; εὐσχημόνως, Re 13:13, I Th 4:12; ἀξίως, c. gen., Eph 4:1, Col 1:10, I Th 2:12; καθώς (ὥς), Eph 4:175:8, 15, Phl 3:17, I Th 4:1; οὕτως ὥς, I Co 7:17; seq. nom. qual., Phl 3:18; c. dat., Ac 21:21, Ro 13:13, II Co 12:18, Ga 5:16; seq. ἐν, Ro 6:4, II Co 4:25:710:3, Eph 2:2, 104:175:2, Col 3:74:5, He 13:9, II Jo 4, 6, al.; ἐν Χριστῷ, Col 2:6; κατά, c. acc., Mk 7:5, Ro 8:414:15, I Co 3:3, II Co 10:2, II Jo 6 (cf. ἐν-περιπατέω).

Πέτρος.sd: a (piece of) rock (larger than G3037 (λίθος)); as a name, Petrus, an apostle
Πέτρος.as:
Πέτρος, -ου, ὁ (i.e. a stone, v.s. πέτρα, Κηφᾶς),
Simon Peter, the Apostle: Mt 4:1810:2, Mk 3:16, Lk 5:8, Jo 1:41, 43, al.

περιάγω.long: I lead or carry about (or around), go about, traverse.
περιάγω.sd: to take around (as a companion); reflexively, to walk around
περιάγω.as:
περι-άγω,
[in LXX: Am 2:10 (הלךְ hi.); Is 28:27, Ez 47:2 (סבב hi., ho.); Ez 37:246:21 (עבר hi), II Mac 4:386:10*;]
1.to lead about or around: c. acc. pers., I Co 9:5.
2. Intrans., to go about: Ac 13:11; seq. ἐν, Mt 4:23; c. acc. loc. (governed by the περι-, not so in cl., v. Bl., § 34, 1; 53, 1), Mt 9:3523:15, Mk 6:6.†

πενθέω.sd: to grieve (the feeling or the act)
πενθέω.as:
πενθέω, -ῶ,
[in LXX chiefly for אבל;]
to mourn (for), lament;
(a) intrans. : Mt 5:4 (5) 9:15, I Co 5:2; π. καὶ κλαίειν, Mt 16:10, Lk 6:25, Ja 4:9, Re 18:15, 19; seq. ἐπί, c. acc., Re 18:11;
(b) trans., c. acc., II Co 12:21.†
SYN.: v.s. θρηνέω.

περισσεύω.long: (a) intrans: I exceed the ordinary (the necessary), abound, overflow; am left over, (b) trans: I cause to abound.
περισσεύω.sd: to superabound (in quantity or quality), be in excess, be superfluous; also (transitively) to cause to superabound or excel
περισσεύω.kj: (make, more) abound, (have, have more) abundance (be more) abundant, be the better, enough and to spare, exceed, excel, increase, be left, redound, remain (over and above)
περισσεύω.as:
περισσεύω
(< περισσός), [in LXX: I Ki 2:33 (מַרְבִּית), I Ki 2:36, Ec 3:19 (יתר ni., יוׄתֵר), To 4:16, Si 10:2711:1219:24, 30:38 (33:29), I Mac 3:30*;]
I. Prop., intrans.,
1. of things, to be over and above the number (Hes.), hence,
(a)to be or remain over: Mt 14:2015:37, Lk 9:17, Jo 6:12, 13;
(b)to abound, be in abundance: Mk 12:44, Lk 12:1521:4, Ac 16:5, Ro 3:75:15, II Co 1:58:29:12, Phl 1:26.
2. Of persons,
(a)to abound in, have in abundance: I Co 14:1215:58, Phl 4:12, 18; c. gen., Lk 15:17 T;
(b)to be superior or better, to excel: absol., I Co 3:98:8; c. dat. ref., II Co 3:9; seq. ἐν, Ro 15:13, I Co 15:58, II Co 3:98:7, Col 2:7; μᾶλλον, I Th 4:1, 10; μ καὶ μ., Phl 1:9; πλεῖον, Mt 5:20.
II. In late writers (Lft., Notes, 48 f.), trans.,
(a)to make to abound: c. acc. seq. εἰς, II Co 4:159:8, Eph 1:8; pass., Mt 13:1225:29; c. gen. rei, Lk 15:17, WH;
(b)to make to excel: c. acc. pers., dat. rei, I Th 3:12 (cf. ὑπερ-περισσεύω).†
SYN.: πλεονάζω.

περισσός.long: more, greater, excessive, abundant, exceedingly, vehemently; noun: preeminence, advantage.
περισσός.sd: superabundant (in quantity) or superior (in quality); by implication, excessive; adverbially (with G1537 (ἐκ)) violently; neuter (as noun) preeminence
περισσός.kj: exceeding abundantly above, more abundantly, advantage, exceedingly, very highly, beyond measure, more, superfluous, vehement(-ly)
περισσός.der: from G4012 (περί) (in the sense of beyond);
περισσός.as:
περισσός, -ή, -όν,
[in LXX for יֶתֶר and cogn. forms;]
1.more than sufficient, over and above, abundant: Jo 10:10, II Co 9:1; c. gen. (a popular substitute for πλειών, Bl., § 11, 34), Mt 5:37; id. c. ellips. gen., Mt 5:47 (EV, more than others; but v. infr.); ἐκ περισσοῦ, Mk 6:51, Rec., T. (on ὑπὲρ ὲκ π., v.s. ὑπερεκπερισσοῦ). Compar. neut., -ότερον: Lk 12:4, 48; c. gen., Mk 12:33; adverbially (cf. περισσῶς), more abundantly, II Co 10:8, He 6:177:15; c. gen., π. πάντων, I Co 15:10; pleonast., μᾶλλον π., Mk 7:36.
2.out of the common, pre-eminent, superior: Mt 5:47 (Thayer, s.v., but v. supr.); τὸ π., as subst., Ro 3:1; compar., -ότερος, c. gen., Mt 11:9, Lk 7:26; c. subst., Mk 12:40, Lk 20:47, I Co 12:23, 24, II Co 2:7.†

πειρασμός.long: (a) trial, probation, testing, being tried, (b) temptation, (c) calamity, affliction.
πειρασμός.sd: a putting to proof (by experiment (of good), experience (of evil), solicitation, discipline or provocation); by implication, adversity
πειρασμός.as:
† πειρασμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(< πειράζω), [in LXX for מַסָּה, עִנְיָן;]
1. = πεῖρα, an experiment (Diosc.).
2.a trial, of ethical purpose and effect, whether good or evil (v. Hort on Ja 1:13);
(a) in good or neutral sense: Ga 4:14, Ja 1:12, I Pe 4:12; esp. of afflictions sent by God (De 7:19, Si 2:1, al.): II Pe 2:9, Re 3:10; pl., Lk 22:28, Ac 20:19, Ja 1:2, I Pe 1:6;
(b) of trial regarded as leading to sin, temptation: Lk 8:13, I Co 10:13, I Ti 6:9; of the temptation of Jesus by the devil, Lk 4:13; εἰσφέρειν (ἔρχεσθαι, εἰσέρχ-) εἰς π., Mt 6:1326:41, Mk 14:38, Lk 11:422:40, 46;
(c) of the testing or challenge of God by man (v.s. πειράζω, 3, c.): He 3:8 (LXX: Ps 94 (95):9, where κατὰ τ. ἡμέραν πειρασμοῦ = מַסָּהכְּיוֹםas the day of Massah).†
SYN.: δοκίμιον.

πετεινόν.der: neuter of a derivative of G4072 (πέτομαι);
πετεινόν.as:
πετεινός, -ή, -όν
(< πέτομαι), [in LXX chiefly for עוֹף;]
in trag., Ion. and late writers, winged, flying; as subst., τὸ π., a winged fowl, a bird: pl., Mt 6:268:2013:4, 32, Mk 4:4, 32, Lk 8:59:5812:2413:19, Ac 10:1211:6, Ro 1:23, Ja 3:7.†

περιβάλλω.long: I cast around, wrap a garment about, put on; hence mid: I put on to myself, clothe myself, dress; I draw (a line).
περιβάλλω.sd: to throw all around, i.e. invest (with a palisade or with clothing)
περιβάλλω.kj: array, cast about, clothe(-d me), put on
περιβάλλω.as:
περι-βάλλω,
[in LXX chiefly for כּסה pi., also for לבשׁ, עטה, etc.;]
to throw around or over, put on or over;
(a) of siege or defensive works: χάρακά σοι, Lk 19:43 (WH, mg.; παρεμβ-, WH, txt.);
(b) of clothing, to put on, wrap about, clothe with: c. acc. rei, Lk 23:11; c. acc. pers., Mt 25:36, 38, 43; c. dupl. acc. (not cl.; Bl., § 34, 4), Jo 19:2; pf. pass., to have wrapped round one: c. acc. rei (cl.), Mk 14:5116:5, Re 7:9, 1310:111:312:117:418:1619:13; c. dat. rei, Re 4:4 (WH, txt.; seq. ἐν, WH, mg.); fut., seq. ἐν (cf. De 22:12, Ps 44 (45):9, 13), Re 3:5. Mid., to clothe oneself, wrap round or put on oneself: absol., Mt 6:29, Lk 12:27, Re 3:18; c. acc. rei, Mt 6:31, Ac 12:8, Re 19:8.†

πέτρα.long: a rock, ledge, cliff, cave, stony ground.
πέτρα.der: feminine of the same as G4074 (Πέτρος);
πέτρα.as:
πέτρα, -ας, ἡ,
[in LXX chiefly for סֶלַע, צוּר;]
a rock, i.e. a mass of live rock as distinct from πέτρος, a detached stone or boulder: Mt 7:24, 2527:51, 60, Mk 15:46, Lk 6:488:6, 13; of a hollow rock, a cave, Re 6:15, 16 (cf. Is 2:10, al.). Metaph., Mt 16:18 (on the meaning, v. Hort, Eccl., 16 ff., but cf. also ICC, in l.), I Co 10:4; = πέτρος, Ro 9:33, I Pe 2:8(LXX).†

πενθερά.as:
πενθερά, -ᾶς, ἡ
(fem. of πενθερός), [in LXX for חָמוֹת;]
a mother-in-law: Mt 8:1410:35, Mk 1:30, Lk 4:3812:53.†

περισσότερος.long: greater, more, even more, more abundantly.
περισσότερος.sd: more superabundant (in number, degree or character)

περίσσευμα.kj: abundance, that was left, over and above
περίσσευμα.as:
† περίσσευμα, -τος, τό
(< περισσεύω), [in LXX: Ec 2:15*;]
that which is over and above, superfluity, abundance: opp. to ὑστέρημα (q.v.), II Co 8:13, 14; pl., Mk 8:8; metaph., π. τ. καρδίας, Mt 12:34, Lk 6:45 (cf. Ec 2:15; Plut., al.).†

πέρας.long: (a) a boundary, limit, extremity, (b) an end, conclusion.
πέρας.as:
πέρας, -ατος, τό
(< πέρα, beyond), [in LXX chiefly for קֵץ, קָצֶה and cognate forms;]
an end, limit, boundary;
(a) of space: chiefly in pl., τὰ π. τ. γῆς, Mt 12:42, Lk 11:31; τ. οἰκουμένης, Ro 10:18(LXX);
(b) (opp. to ἀρχή) the end: c. gen., ἀντιλογίας, He 6:10.†

πετρῶδες.as:
* πετρώδης, -ες
(< πέτρα, εἶδος),
rock-like, rocky, stony: τὸ, τὰ π., of shallow soil with underlying rock, Mt 13:5, 20, Mk 4:5, 16.†

πεζῇ.der: dative case feminine of a derivative of G4228 (πούς) (as adverb);

πέντε.as:
πέντε, indecl., οἱ, αἱ, τά,
five: Mt 14:17, al.

πεντακισχίλιοι.as:
πεντακισ-χίλιοι, -αι, -α,
five thousand: Mt 14:2116:9, Mk 6:448:19, Lk 9:14, Jo 6:10.†

πέλαγος.sd: deep or open sea, i.e. the main
πέλαγος.as:
** πέλαγος, -ους, τό,
[in LXX: II Mac 5:21, IV Mac 7:1*;]
the deep sea, the deep, the sea: Ac 27:5; τὸ π. τῆς θαλάσσης, Mt 18:6.
SYN.: θαλάσσα (q.v.); and cf. ἄβυσσος.

περιτίθημι.long: I place or put around, clothe; fig: I bestow, confer.
περιτίθημι.sd: to place around; by implication, to present
περιτίθημι.kj: bestow upon, hedge round about, put about (on, upon), set about
περιτίθημι.as:
περι-τίθημι,
[in LXX for נתן, שׂוּם, etc.;]
to place or put around: c. acc. et dat., Mt 21:3327:48, Mk 12:115:36, Jo 19:29; of garments, etc., to put on: Mt 27:28Mk 15:17 (Si 6:31). Metaph., like περιβάλλω, to bestow, confer (Thuc., al., Es 1:20): I Co 12:23.†

περίλυπος.sd: grieved all around, i.e. intensely sad
περίλυπος.as:
περί-λυπος, -ον,
[in LXX: Ps 41 (42):5, 11, I Es 8:69, al.;]
very sad, deeply grieved: Mt 26:38, Mk 6:2614:34, Lk 18:23.†

πείθω.sd: to convince (by argument, true or false); by analogy, to pacify or conciliate (by other fair means); reflexively or passively, to assent (to evidence or authority), to rely (by inward certainty)
πείθω.kj: agree, assure, believe, have confidence, be (wax) conflent, make friend, obey, persuade, trust, yield
πείθω.as:
πείθω,
[in LXX chiefly for בּטח, its parts and derivatives;]
(i) Active;
1. trans., to apply persuasion ("conative" in pres.; v. M, Pr., 147), to prevail upon or win over, persuade: absol., Mt 28:14, Ac 19:26; seq. περί, c. gen. rei, Ac 19:8; c. acc. pers., Ac 12:2014:1918:4, II Co 5:11, Ga 1:10; τ. καρδίας ἡμῶν, I Jo 3:19; c. acc. seq. περί, Ac 28:23; c. acc. et inf., Ac 13:4326:28 (v. Field, Notes, 141 ff.); c. acc. seq. ἵνα (Plut.), Mt 27:20.
2. Intrans., 2 pf. πέποιθα with pres. sense (v. M, Pr., 147, 154; Bl., § 59, 2): to trust, be confident, have confidence: c. acc. et inf., Ro 2:19; c. acc. ref. (v. Ellic., in l.) : Phl 1:6, 25; c. dat., Phl 1:14, Phm 21; ἑαυτῷ, c. inf., II Co 10:7; seq. ἐν, Phl 3:3, 4; ἐν κυρίῳ ὅτι, Phl 2:24; ἐπί, c. dat., Mt 27:43 (WH, mg.), Mk 10:24 (T, WH, R, mg., om.), Lk 11:2218:9, II Co 1:9, He 2:13; ἐπί, c. acc., Mt 27:43 (c. dat., WH, mg.); id. seq. ὅτι, II Co 2:3, II Th 3:4 (v. Lft., Notes, 127); εἰς, c. acc. pers. seq. ὅτι, Ga 5:10.
(ii) Pass. and mid.;
1.to be persuaded, believe (v. M, Pr., 158): absol., Lk 16:31, Ac 17:421:14, He 13:18; c. dat., Ac 28:24; c. acc. et inf., Ac 26:26; so also pf., πέπεισμαι, πεπεισμένος εἰμί: c. acc. ref. seq. περί, He 6:9; c. acc. et inf., Lk 20:6; ὅτι, Ro 8:38, II Ti 1:5, 12; id. c. ἐν κυρίῳ, Ro 14:14; περί, c. gen. seq. ὅτι, Ro 15:14.
2.to listen to, obey: c. dat. pers., Ac 5:36, 37, 4023:2127:11, Ro 2:8, Ga 5:7, He 13:17, Ja 3:3 (cf. ἀνα-πείθω).†

περισσῶς.kj: exceedingly, out of measure, the more
περισσῶς.as:
περισσῶς,
adv.
(περισσός), [in LXX: Ps 30 (31):23 (עַל־יֶתֶר), Da TH 7:7, 198:9 (יַתִּירָה, יֶתֶר), II Mac 8:2712:44 A*;]
beyond measure, exceedingly, abundantly: Mt 27:23, Mk 10:2615:14, Ac 26:11. Compar.
(a)περισσότερον (v.s. περισσός);
(b)περισσοτέρως: II Co 1:122:47:1511:23, Ga 1:14, Phl 1:14, I Th 2:17, He 2:113:19; π. μᾶλλον, II Co 7:13; opp. to ἧττον, II Co 12:15.†

περιβλέπομαι.as:
περι-βλέπω,
[in LXX for שׁוּר, etc.;]
to look around (at). Mid., to look about one (at): absol., Mk 9:810:23; c. inf., Mk 5:32; c. acc. pers., Mk 3:5, 34, Lk 6:10; πάντα, Mk 11:11.†

πέδη.long: a shackle, fetter for the feet.
πέδη.as:
πέδη, -ης, ἡ
(< πέζα, the instep), [in LXX for נְחֹשֶׁת, etc.;]
a fetter: Mk 5:4, Lk 8:29.†

πεντήκοντα.as:
πεντήκοντα, indecl., οἱ, αἱ, τά,
fifty: Lk 7:4116:6, Jo 8:5721:11, Ac 13:20; ἀνὰ π., Lk 9:14; κατὰ π., Mk 6:40.†

περιτρέχω.der: from G4012 (περί) and G5143 (τρέχω) (including its alternate);
περιτρέχω.as:
περι-τρέχω,
[in LXX: Am 8:12, Je 5:1 (שׁוּט pi.)*;]
to run about: c. acc. loc., Mk 6:55.†

περιφέρω.g: I carry around, am driven to and fro
περιφέρω.long: I carry around; pass: I am driven to and fro.
περιφέρω.sd: to convey around, i.e. transport hither and thither
περιφέρω.as:
περι-φέρω,
[in LXX: Ec 7:8 (7) (הלל po.), al.;]
to carry about: Mk 6:55, II Co 4:10. Pass., metaph.: Eph 4:14.†

περισσότερον.kj: more abundantly, a great deal, far more

περίκειμαι.long: I lie about, surround; I am encompassed, surrounded, or clothed with, am in submission to.
περίκειμαι.sd: to lie all around, i.e. inclose, encircle, hamper (literally or figuratively)
περίκειμαι.as:
** περί-κειμαι,
[in LXX: Ep. Je 24, 58, IV Mac 12:3*;]
1.to lie round about: μύλος, λίθος (RV, were hanged about), Mk 9:42, Lk 17:2; νεφος μαρτύρων, He 12:1.
2.to have around one, be clothed with: Ac 28:20; fig., ἀσθένειαν, He 5:2.†

περικαλύπτω.long: I cover up, cover round about, veil round, blindfold.
περικαλύπτω.sd: to cover all around, i.e. entirely (the face, a surface)
περικαλύπτω.as:
περι-καλύπτω,
[in LXX for כּסה‎ pi., שׁבץ pu., etc.;]
to cover around, cover up or over: c. acc., Mk 14:65, Lk 22:64; pass., seq. χρυσίῳ, He 9:4.†

περικρύβω.long: I conceal, hide (by putting something around it).
περικρύβω.sd: to conceal all around, i.e. entirely

περίοικος.sd: housed around, i.e. neighboring (used elliptically as a noun)
περίοικος.as:
περί-οικος, -ον,
[in LXX for כִּכָּר, etc.;]
dwelling around; as subst., ὁ π., a neighbour: Lk 1:58 (cf. πλησίον).†

περιτέμνω.sd: to cut around, i.e. (specially) to circumcise
περιτέμνω.der: from G4012 (περί) and the base of G5114 (τομώτερος);
περιτέμνω.as:
περι-τέμνω,
[in LXX chiefly for מוּל;] (Ion., Epic. and late writers),
to cut around (Hdt.), hence, to circumcise (π. τὰ αἰδοῖα, Hdt.): Lk 1:592:21, Jo 7:22, Ac 7:815:516:321:21. Pass. and mid., to be circumcised, receive circumcision: Ac 15:1, I Co 7:18, Ga 2:35:2, 36:12, 13. Metaph. (cf. De 10:16, Je 4:4, al.), Col 2:11 (v. Deiss., BS, 151 f.; MM, xix).†

περιοικέω.long: I dwell around, am neighboring to.
περιοικέω.sd: to reside around, i.e. be a neighbor
περιοικέω.as:
* περι-οικέω, -ῶ,
to dwell round about: c. acc., Lk 1:65.†

περιλάμπω.sd: to illuminate all around, i.e. invest with a halo
περιλάμπω.as:
*† περι-λάμπω:
to shine around: c. acc., Lk 2:9, Ac 26:13.†

πεντεκαιδέκατος.der: from G4002 (πέντε) and G2532 (καί) and G1182 (δέκατος);

περιέχω.long: (a) I contain (of a book containing subject matter); hence: it stands (has its content) thus, (b) I encompass, surround, get hold of, seize.
περιέχω.sd: to hold all around, i.e. include, clasp (figuratively)
περιέχω.as:
περι-έχω,
[in LXX for אפף, נקף hi., צפה pi., etc.;]
1.to surround, encompass: Lk 5:9 (cf. MM, xix).
2.to comprehend, include, contain, esp. of books: c. acc., Ac 23:25, Rec.; acc. to a late usage, intrans. (Bl., § 53, 13; MM, xix; Hort, in l.), it stands written, I Pe 2:6.†

πεδινός.der: from a derivative of G4228 (πούς) (meaning the ground);
πεδινός.as:
πεδινός, -ή, -όν
(< πεδίον, a plain), [in LXX chiefly for הַשְּׁפֵלָה (ἡ π.);]
level, plain: Lk 6:17.†

περιπίπτω.g: I fall into the midst of
περιπίπτω.long: I fall into the midst of, am involved in, happen upon a place.
περιπίπτω.sd: to fall into something that is all around, i.e. light among or upon, be surrounded with
περιπίπτω.as:
περι-πίπτω,
[in LXX: Ru 2:3, II Ki 1:6 (קרה), Pr 11:5 (נפל), Da LXX 2:9, II Mac 6:139:7, 2110:4*;]
1.to fall around.
2.to fall in with, light upon, come across: c. dat., λῃσταῖς, Lk 10:30; πειρασμοῖς, Ja 1:2; seq. εἰς, Ac 27:41.†

περισπάομαι.sd: to drag all around, i.e. (figuratively) to distract (with care)
περισπάομαι.as:
περι-σπάω, -ῶ,
[in LXX chiefly for ענה;]
to draw around, draw off or away. Metaph., to distract: pass., Lk 10:40.†

περιζώννυμι.long: I gird round; mid: I gird myself, generally for active work or travel.
περιζώννυμι.sd: to gird all around, i.e. (middle voice or passive) to fasten on one's belt (literally or figuratively)
περιζώννυμι.as:
περι-ζώννυμι and -ύω
(v. Veitch, s.v.) [in LXX chiefly for חגר, also for אזר, etc.;]
to gird (c. dupl. acc., as ὁ περιζωννύων με δύναμιν, Ps 17 (18):32): pass., αἱ ὀσφύες περιεζωσμέναι, Lk 12:35; π. ζώνην χρυσῆν, Re 1:1315:6 (but v. infr.). Mid., to gird oneself: Lk 12:3717:8 (and so perh. Re 1:1315:6 supr., cf. I Ki 2:4); c. acc. rei (fig.), τ. ὀσφύν, Eph 6:14 (seq. ἐν, cf. I Ch 15:27).†

περιποιέομαι.long: I acquire, earn, purchase, make my own, preserve alive.
περιποιέομαι.sd: to make around oneself, i.e. acquire (buy)
περιποιέομαι.der: middle voice from G4012 (περί) and G4160 (ποιέω);
περιποιέομαι.as:
περι-ποιέω, -ῶ,
[in LXX for חיה pi., hi., etc.;]
to make to remain over, preserve. Mid.,
(a)to keep or save for oneself: τ. ψυχήν (cf. Xen., Cyr., iv, 4, 10; Arist., Pol., v, 11, 30), Lk 17:33;
(b)to get or gain for oneself, get possession of (Thuc., Xen., al.): Ac 20:28, I Ti 3:13.†

περικυκλόω.sd: to encircle all around, i.e. blockade completely
περικυκλόω.as:
περι-κυκλόω, -ῶ,
[in LXX chiefly for סבב;]
to encircle, encompass: of a besieged city, Lk 19:43.†

πενιχρός.der: prolongation from the base of G3993 (πένης);
πενιχρός.as:
πενιχρός, -ά, -όν
(< πένομαι, v.s. πένης), [in LXX: Ex 22:25 (עָנִי), Pr 28:1529:7 (דַּל)*;] chiefly in Comic poets and late prose (but Plato, Rep., 578 A), = πένης,
needy, poor: Lk 21:2 (for ex. in π., v. MM, xix).†

περιάπτω.as:
** περι-άπτω,
[in LXX: III Mac 3:7*;]
1.to tie about, attach.
2. In late writers, to light a fire around, kindle: πῦρ, Lk 22:55.†

περιτομή.sd: circumcision (the rite, the condition or the people, literally or figuratively)
περιτομή.as:
† περι-τομή, -ῆς, ἡ
(< περιτέμνω), [in LXX: Ge 17:13, Ex 4:25, 26 (מוּל ni., מוּלָה), Je 11:16*;]
circumcision;
(a) of the rite itself: Jo 7:22, 23, Ac 7:8, Ro 4:11, Ga 5:11, Phl 3:5;
(b) of the state of circumcision: Ro 2:25-283:1, I Co 7:19, Ga 5:66:15, Col 3:11; ἐν π. ὤν, Ro 4:10;
(c) by meton., ἡ π. = οἱ περιτμηθέντες, the circumcised: Ro 3:304:9, 1215:8, Ga 2:7-9, Eph 2:11; οἱ ἐκ τῆς π., of Jews, Ro 4:12; of Jewish Christians, Ac 11:2, Ga 2:12, Tit 1:10; οἱ ἐκ π. πιστοί, Ac 10:45; οἱ ὄντες ἐκ π., Col 4:11. Metaph., Ro 2:29, Col 2:11, Phl 3:3.†

περιΐστημι.long: in intrans. act. tenses: I stand around; mid: I avoid, shun.
περιΐστημι.sd: to stand all around, i.e. (near) to be a bystander, or (aloof) to keep away from
περιΐστημι.as:
περι-ίστημι (Rec. ΐστημι),
[in LXX: Jos 6:3 (סבב), II Ki 13:31 (נצב ni.), I Ki 4:16, Ep. Je 37, Jth 5:22, II Mac 14:9*;]
1.to place around.
2.to stand around: Jo 11:42; c. acc. pers., Ac 25:7. Mid. (in late writers), to turn oneself about to avoid, to shun: c. acc. rei, II Ti 2:16, Tit 3:9.†

περιδέω.sd: to bind around one, i.e. enwrap
περιδέω.as:
περι-δέω,
[in LXX: Jb 12:18 (אסר)*;]
to tie round, bind round: c. acc. et dat., pass., Jo 11:44.†

πενθερός.as:
πενθερός, -οῦ, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for חָם, Ge 38:13, al.; also for חֹתֵן, Jg 1:16 A;]
a father-in-law: Jo 18:13.†

περιμένω.as:
περι-μένω,
[in LXX: Ge 49:18 (קוה pi.), Wi 8:12*;]
to wait for: c. acc.., Ac 1:4.†

πεντηκοστή.long: Pentecost, a feast of the Jews, the fiftieth day after Passover.
πεντηκοστή.sd: fiftieth (G2250 (ἡμέρα) being implied) from Passover, i.e. the festival of "Pentecost"
πεντηκοστή.der: feminine of the ordinal of G4004 (πεντήκοντα);

πέριξ.sd: all around, i.e. (as an adjective) circumjacent
πέριξ.as:
** πέριξ,
adv.,
[in Al.: Le 13:33*;]
round about: αἱ π. πολεῖς, Ac 5:16.†

πειθαρχέω.long: I obey one in authority, conform to advice, obey, follow.
πειθαρχέω.sd: to be persuaded by a ruler, i.e. (genitive case) to submit to authority; by analogy, to conform to advice
πειθαρχέω.der: from a compound of G3982 (πείθω) and G757 (ἄρχω);
πειθαρχέω.as:
πειθαρχέω, -ῶ
(< πείθομαι, ἀρχή), [in LXX: Da LXX 7:27 (שְׁמַע), Si 30:38 (33:28), I Es 8:94*;]
to obey one in authority, be obedient: Tit 3:1; c. dat., Ac 27:21; θεῷ, Ac 5:29, 32.†

περιοχή.long: a section or passage of Scripture.
περιοχή.sd: a being held around, i.e. (concretely) a passage (of Scripture, as circumscribed)
περιοχή.as:
περι-οχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(< περιέχω), [in LXX for מְצוּדָה, מָצוֹר, etc.;]
1.compass, circumference.
2.a portion circumscribed, a section: Ac 8:32.†

περιαστράπτω.sd: to flash all around, i.e. envelop in light
περιαστράπτω.as:
**† περι-αστράπτω,
[in LXX: IV Mac 4:10*;]
to flash around: c. acc., Ac 9:3; seq. περίAc 22:6 (Eccl. and Byzant.).†

Πέργη.long: Perga, a city on the river Cestrus in the Roman province Pamphylia.
Πέργη.sd: a tower; Perga, a place in Asia Minor
Πέργη.der: probably from the same as G4010 (Πέργαμος);
Πέργη.as:
Πέργη, -ης, ἡ,
Perga, a city of Pamphylia: Ac 13:13, 1414:25.†

περιρήγνυμι.long: I tear off, as of garments.
περιρήγνυμι.sd: to tear all around, i.e. completely away
περιρήγνυμι.as:
** περι-ρήγνυμι (Rec. -ρρ-, v. supr.),
[in LXX: II Mac 4:38*;]
to break or tear off all around: freq. of garments, τ. ἱμάτια, Ac 16:22.†

περιέρχομαι.g: I move about, make a circuit, tack
περιέρχομαι.long: I go around, move about, visit; I make a circuit, tack (as a ship).
περιέρχομαι.sd: to come all around, i.e. stroll, vacillate, veer
περιέρχομαι.kj: fetch a compass, vagabond, wandering about
περιέρχομαι.der: from G4012 (περί) and G2064 (ἔρχομαι) (including its alternate);
περιέρχομαι.as:
περι-έρχομαι,
[in LXX chiefly for סבב;]
to go about (as an itinerant): Ac 19:1328:13 (περιελόντες, WH, R, mg.), He 11:37; τ. οἰκίας, from house to house: I Ti 5:13.†

περίεργος.long: of persons: over-careful; curious, meddling, a busy-body; of things: over-wrought; superfluous; curious, uncanny; subst: curious arts, magic.
περίεργος.sd: working all around, i.e. officious (meddlesome, neuter plural magic)
περίεργος.as:
* περίεργος, -ον,
I. of persons;
1.over careful.
2.curious, meddling, a busybody: I Ti 5:13.
II. Of things;
1.over-wrought.
2.superfluous.
3.curious, uncanny; τὰ π., curious arts, magic: Ac 19:19 (v. Deiss., BS, 3235.).†

περαιτέρω.as:
* περαιτέρω
(< πέρα, beyond),
compar. adv.,
beyond: Ac 19:39, L, Tr., WH (T, Rec., R, περὶ ἑτέρων).†

πεζεύω.long: I travel on foot, by land.
πεζεύω.sd: to foot a journey, i.e. travel by land
πεζεύω.as:
* πεζεύω
(< πεζός),
to travel on foot or by land: Ac 20:13.†

πειράω.as:
πειράω, more commonly as depon., πειράομαι,
[in LXX for נסה;]
to try, attempt: Ac 26:21.†

περιτρέπω.sd: to turn around, i.e. (mentally) to craze
περιτρέπω.der: from G4012 (περί) and the base of G5157 (τροπή);
περιτρέπω.as:
** περι-τρέπω,
[in LXX: Wi 5:23*;]
to turn about, turn: c. acc. et, dat., Ac 26:24 (cf. FlJ, Ant., ix, 4, 4).†

περικρατής.long: having full power over, mastering, gaining control over.
περικρατής.sd: strong all around, i.e. a master (manager)
περικρατής.as:
**† περι-κρατής, -ές,
[in LXX: Da TH Sus 39 A*;]
having full command of: Ac 27:16.†

περιαιρέω.long: (a) I strip off, strip from, take away, (b) I cast off, cut adrift, cast loose.
περιαιρέω.sd: to remove all around, i.e. unveil, cast off (anchor); figuratively, to expiate
περιαιρέω.der: from G4012 (περί) and G138 (αἱρέομαι) (including its alternate);
περιαιρέω.as:
περι-αιρέω, -ῶ,
[in LXX chiefly for סוּר hi.;]
to take away that which surrounds, take away, take off (τείχη, Hdt., Thuc.; χιτῶνα, Plat.; δακτύλιον, Ge 41:42, cf. σφρηγῖδα, Hdt., ii, 151): τ. κάλυμμα, pass., II Co 3:16; as nautical term (RV, cast off), ἀγκύρας, Ac 27:40; absol., to cast loose: Ac 28:13. Metaph., to take away entirely: ἐλπίς, pass., Ac 27:20; ἁμαρτίας, He 10:11.†

περισσεία.as:
† περισσεία, -ας, ἡ
(< περισσεύω), [in LXX: Ec12 (יִתְרוֹן and cogn. forms, 1:3, al.)*;]
1.abundance, superfluity: Ro 5:17, II Co 8:210:15, Ja 1:21 (so also Inscr., v. LAE, 80).
2.
(a)superiority (Ec, v. supr.);
(b)profit (ib.).†

Περσίς.long: Persis, name of a Christian lady in Rome.
Περσίς.sd: a Persian woman; Persis, a Christian female

πειθός.as:
*† πειθός (πιθός, WH), -ή, -όν
(< πείθω), = cl. πιθανός,
persuasive: I Co 2:4 (not found elsewhere).†

περικάθαρμα.sd: something cleaned off all around, i.e. refuse (figuratively)
περικάθαρμα.der: from a compound of G4012 (περί) and G2508 (καθαίρω);
περικάθαρμα.as:
† περι-κάθαρμα, -τος, τό
(< περικαθαίρω, to purify on all sides or completely, De 18:10, Jos 5:4, IV Mac 1:29*), [in LXX: Pr 21:18 (כֹּפֶר)*;]
1.a victim, expiation (Pr 21:18).
2.refuse, rubbish: pl., I Co 4:13 (v. ICC, in l.).†

περίψημα.sd: something brushed all around, i.e. off-scrapings (figuratively, scum)
περίψημα.der: from a comparative of G4012 (περί) and (to rub);
περίψημα.as:
**† περί-ψημα, -τος, τό
(< περιψράω, to wipe off all round), [in LXX: To 5:18*;]
that which is wiped off, offscouring: metaph. (assoc. with περικάθαρμα, q.v.), I Co 4:13 (and so prob., To 5:18, as EV; but v. Thayer, s.v., for the meaning expiation, ransom, in To; and cf. LS, s.v. κάθαρμα; Lft., Notes, 200 f., and on Ign., Eph., 8).†

περιβόλαιον.long: a wrapper, mantle, veil, cloak, covering.
περιβόλαιον.sd: something thrown around one, i.e. a mantle, veil
περιβόλαιον.der: neuter of a presumed derivative of G4016 (περιβάλλω);
περιβόλαιον.as:
περι-βόλαιον, -ου, τό
(< περιβάλλω), [in LXX chiefly for לְבוּשׁ, כְּסוּת and cognate forms;]
that which is thrown around, a covering, in NT,
(a)a mantle (Ps 101 (102):27, Is 59:17, al.): He 1:12(LXX);
(b)a veil: I Co 11:15 (but v. ICC, in l.).†

περπερεύομαι.sd: perhaps by reduplication of the base of G4008 (πέραν)); to boast
περπερεύομαι.as:
*† περπερεύομαι
(< περπερος, vainglorious),
to boast or vaunt oneself: I Co 13:4 (elsewh. only in Antonin.; v. Abbott, Essays, 87).†

περισσοτέρως.kj: more abundant(-ly), X the more earnest, (more) exceedingly, more frequent, much more, the rather

πεποίθησις.der: from the perfect of the alternate of G3958 (πάσχω);
πεποίθησις.as:
† πεποίθησις, -εως, ἡ
(< πείθω), [in LXX: IV Ki 18:19 (בִּטָּחוֹן)*;]
confidence: II Co 1:153:410:2, Eph 3:12; seq. εἰς, II Co 8:22; ἐν, Phl 3:4 (the word is condemned by the Atticists, v. Rutherford, NPhr., 355).†

πέρυσι(ν).sd: the by-gone, i.e. (as noun) last year
πέρυσι(ν).as:
*† πέρυσι,
adv.
(< πέρας),
last year, a year ago: ἀπὸ π. (as in π. v. Deiss., BS, 221; LAE, 70), II Co 8:109:2.†

πένης.long: one who works for his living; a laborer, poor man.
πένης.der: from a primary (to toil for daily subsistence);
πένης.as:
πένης, -ητος, ὁ
(< πένομαι, to work for one's daily bread), [in LXX for אֶבְיוֹן, עָנִי, דַּל, etc.;]
one who works for his living, a labourer, a poor man: II Co 9:9.†
SYN.: πτωχός, properly a beggar and implying deeper poverty than π. (v. Tr., Syn., § xxxvi; Abbott, Essays, 78).

πεισμονή.long: persuasion, conviction, a yielding to persuasion.
πεισμονή.der: from a presumed derivative of G3982 (πείθω);

περιποίησις.sd: acquisition (the act or the thing); by extension, preservation
περιποίησις.as:
† περι-ποίησις, -εως, ἡ
(< περιποιέω), [in LXX: II Ch 4:13 (12) (מִחְיָה), Ma 3:17 (סְגֻלָּה), Hg 2:10 (9)*;]
1.preservation: He 10:39 (II Ch 4:13).
2.acquisition, obtaining: I Th 5:9, II Th 2:14 (and so perh. Eph 1:14, v. infr.).
3.a possession: Eph 1:14 (but v. supr., and cf. ICC, in l.), I Pe 2:9(LXX).†

περικεφαλαία.sd: encirclement of the head, i.e. a helmet
περικεφαλαία.der: feminine of a compound of G4012 (περί) and G2776 (κεφαλή);
περικεφαλαία.as:
† περι-κεφαλαία, -ας, ἡ,
[in LXX for כּוֹבַע, קוֹבַע;]
a helmet: fig., I Th 5:8; c. gen. explic., π. τ. σωτηρίου, Eph 6:17 (cf. Is 59:17).†

περιλείπομαι.long: I leave behind; pass: I am left behind, remain, survive.
περιλείπομαι.sd: to leave all around, i.e. (passively) survive
περιλείπομαι.as:
περι-λείπομαι, depon. mid. and pass.,
[in LXX: II Ch 34:21 A (שׁאר ni.), II Mac 1:318:14, IV Mac 12:613:18*;]
to be left remaining, remain over, survive: I Th 4:15, 17.†

περιεργάζομαι.long: I overdo, am a busybody, waste my labor about (a thing).
περιεργάζομαι.sd: to work all around, i.e. bustle about (meddle)
περιεργάζομαι.as:
** περι-εργάζομαι,
[in LXX: Wi 8:5א1, Si 3:23*;]
1.to waste one's labour about a thing.
2.to be a busybody: II Th 3:11 (cf. Plat., Apol., 19 B).†

περιπείρω.long: I put on a spit; met: I pierce, wound deeply.
περιπείρω.der: from G4012 (περί) and the base of G4008 (πέραν);
περιπείρω.as:
*† περι-πείρω,
to put on a spit, hence, to pierce: metaph., ἑαυτὸν . . . ὀδύναις, I Ti 6:10.†

περιούσιος.sd: being beyond usual, i.e. special (one's own)
περιούσιος.der: from the present participle feminine of a compound of 4012 and G1510 (εἰμί);
περιούσιος.as:
† περιούσιος, -ον
(< περίειμι, to be over and above), [in LXX: Ex 19:523:22, De 7:614:226:18 (סְגֻלָּה, עַם ם׳)*;]
one's own, of one's own possession: λαὸς π. (cf. LXX, Ex 19:523:22, De 7:614:226:18), Tit 2:14.†

περιφρονέω.as:
** περι-φρονέω, -ῶ,
[in LXX: IV Mac 6:914:1*;]
1.to examine on all sides, consider carefully (Aristoph.).
2. = ὑπερφρονέω, to have thouphts beyond, to despise (Thuc., Plut., al.; IV Mac 6:914:1): Tit 2:15.†

πεῖρα.der: from the base of G4008 (πέραν) (through the idea of piercing);
πεῖρα.as:
πεῖρα, -ας, ἡ
(< πειράω), [in LXX: De 28:56 (π. λαμβάνειν, נסה pi.) 33:8 (מַסָּה), Wi 18:20, 25, II Mac 8:9, IV Mac 8:1*;]
a trial, experiment; π. λαμβάνειν, to make trial, have experience of: He 11:29, 36 (for exx., v. Field, Notes, 232 f.).†

πένθος.der: strengthened from the alternate of G3958 (πάσχω);
πένθος.as:
πένθος, -ους, τό,
[in LXX chiefly for אֵבֶל;]
mourning: Ja 4:9, Re 18:7, 821:4.†

περίθεσις.long: a putting around or on (as of ornaments).
περίθεσις.sd: a putting all around, i.e. decorating oneself with
περίθεσις.as:
**† περί-θεσις, -εως, ἡ
(< περιτίθημι), [in Sm.: Ps 31 (32):9*;]
a putting around, putting on: I Pe 3:3.†

Πέργαμος.long: Pergamum, an important city of the Roman province Asia.
Πέργαμος.sd: fortified; Pergamus, a place in Asia Minor
Πέργαμος.as:
Πέργαμος, -ου, ἡ
(so Xen., Paus., al., but -ον, τό in Strabo, Polyb., and most writers, also in Inscr.; in NT the termination is uncertain),
Pergamum, a city of Mysia: Re 1:112:12.†

πέτομαι.der: middle voice of a primary verb;
πέτομαι.as:
πέτομαι,
[in LXX chiefly for עוּף;]
to fly: Re 4:78:1312:1414:619:17 (Rec. πετάομαι, q.v.).†

πέμπτος.as:
πέμπτος, -η, -ον,
[in LXX for חֲמִישִׁי and cognate forms;]
fifth: Re 6:99:116:1021:20.†

πελεκίζω.sd: to chop off (the head), i.e. truncate
πελεκίζω.der: from a derivative of G4141 (πλήσσω) (meaning an axe);
πελεκίζω.as:
*† πελεκίζω
(< πέλεκυς, a battle-axe),
to out off with an axe, esp. to behead: c. acc., Re 20:4 (Polyb., al.).†
